securityPosture.note: Re-derived from the migrations on 2026-09-19..20, not from the advisor summary alone. Design is sound; the gap is test coverage.
securityPosture.advisorDiscrepancy: The Supabase advisor reports 24 authenticated SECURITY DEFINER functions. The true figure is 23; the advisor counts the 4 anon RFQ functions, which are granted to both anon and authenticated, against a set that also includes them.
openFindings: P1: no behavioural test for any of the 4 anon RFQ endpoints. Wrong token, expired respond_by, deactivated supplier company and cross-request requestItemId are all unasserted. Only grant presence is tested.
P1: no negative test for select_order_plan, assign_order_concierge, assign_supplier_rfq, request_supplier_quote_revision, decline_supplier_rfq, or the 6 service_role-only queue RPCs.

P2: the 0042 privilege sweep and its regression test both filter on prosecdef, so SECURITY INVOKER trigger functions are never swept and retain create-time grants. 0043 grants EXECUTE to authenticated by default, so each new trigger function needs an explicit REVOKE that nothing enforces.
P2: createJuryMetricsClient() bypasses RLS and is guarded only by call-site discipline in apps/web/app/metrics/page.tsx; isValidJuryToken() is not enforced inside the factory.
P3: the comment in apps/web/lib/supabase/admin.ts claims service-role is isolated to one owner-only invitation action; there are 8 call sites.

externalRequirements: Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Vercel production. /api/ready checks exactly three variables and the database is ACTIVE_HEALTHY, so this alone should return it to 200.
Set CRON_SECRET in both Vercel production and GitHub Actions repository secrets, with the same value in both, or the workflow bearer token will not match.
Set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM_EMAIL in Vercel production, and fix the silent local-sink fallback so a missing key can never report delivery.
Enable leaked-password protection in Supabase Auth.
A tested backup and restore procedure for database, Auth and private files.
A Kazakhstan data-residency decision before any real personal data is used.
A real pilot company, supplier and bank-transfer operator.
Run the manual strict release gate (release.yml, strict=true, ready_url=<deployment>) once /api/ready returns 200.
